plain_english_policy: This bill (HB619) shifts regulatory authority over junkyards from municipalities to counties in Alabama’s unincorporated areas (outside city limits), but only after imposing stricter procedural hurdles for municipal licensing. It does not fundamentally alter state-level oversight, nor does it create new substantive restrictions on junkyard operations—it merely reallocates local enforcement power and requires public input before any new licenses are granted in suburban police jurisdictions.
